profile.headline: Software Engineer II at Microsoft
profile.summary: Experienced Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the e-learning industry. Skilled in Databases, Web Applications, Algorithms and Customer Satisfaction with over 8 years of experience in the software industry. Strong engineering professional with a Master of Science - MS focused in Computer Science from The University of Texas at Dallas.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Working as software engineer for Microsoft Viva Insights
Microsoft Viva Insights helps people and business thrive with data-driven, privacy-protected insights and recommendations to improve productivity and wellbeing; reimagine employee experience by empowering people, teams, and organizations to focus on what’s important, achieve balance, and build resilience.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
•	Develop end to end modules for Support Portal, an internal tool used by the UWorld Customer Support, to manage User related Information like subscriptions, payments, and various other features.
•	Enhancement and addition of features to Support Portal.
•	Redesign the entire payment structure of UWorld Support Portal from ASP.NET to Angular 7.
•	Design and develop Customer Support module for Learning Platform used by schools to manage the student, classrooms, and Implementations.
•	Created UWorld Press Release platform using BlogEngine and KbVault .NET MVC.
•	Developing and maintaining Faculty Portal, a portal used by schools to manage faculty, classrooms and its students.

Used Technologies: C#, ASP.NET, JavaScript, Bootstrap, HTML, SCSS, Angular 7, SQL, LINQ, Web Services.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Enhancing and re-building responsive UWorld web portal to enhance user experience.
• Developed web pages for the UWorld website (www.uworld.com).
• Contributing to the development of existing web applications in terms of feature enhancement.

Used Technologies: C#, ASP.NET, JavaScript, Bootstrap, HTML, SCSS, Angular 7, SQL, LINQ, Web Services..

positions.title: Intern - Data Scientist
positions.description:
•  Implemented a logger based REST API application which retrieves data from Hadoop Storage and Databases, Hive and HBase
                     - Implemented data retrival features such as sorting, filtering and pagination for SQL data bases like HIVE
                     - Implemented secondary indexing for enabling sorting on non row key fields in HBase

•  Building a Machine Learning ChatBot in Python with RASA NLU and RASA Core with spaCy pipeline and Sklearn
                     - Implementing intent and entity classification with RASA NLU
                     - Training the model for Named Entity Recognition of text using SpaCy.

Used Technologies: Java, REST, Hadoop, Hive, Spring MVC.

positions.title: Applications Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed tool in Java for migrating setups from Oracle CRM On Demand to Oracle Sales Cloud, which assess the CRM On Demand environment and ensure that the Oracle Sales Cloud environment is setup as required by the utility.

• Automated the tools for migrating solutions from Oracle CRM On Demand to Oracle Sales Cloud which would improve the performance of the migration using selenium web driver using IDEs like Eclipse and using developer tools like Firebug with the XPath technology.

• Developed agile user stories related to web services in Core Java, JSP, Servlets, JavaScript and C++ using IDEs like Visual Studio and Oracle JDeveloper and delivered them successfully using tools like ClearCase and putty.

• Analyzed the issues logged by the customers, identifying the root cause through advanced debugging of the code IDEs like Visual Studio and Oracle JDeveloper, and finally resolving the bugs without any regressions.

• Designed and developed user stories in Oracle Sales Cloud Vertical development phase with the use of scripting language, Groovy and using REST API’s to ensure that user can add, delete and update data through web services.

• Generated the WSDL using XML, developed the web service feature and tested the REST API service using SOAP UI.

• Developed script for continuously monitoring the performance of the REST services using CURL commands so as to quickly capture the failures when it occurs and thus preventing further issues.

• Developed test cases for the Promotion projects and automated them using Oracle Application Testing Suites to report issues related to quality, errors and software release with zero error margin.

projects.title: Tailored Shielding  And Bypass Testing of Web Applications
projects.description:
. Front End: Java 
. Back End: MySQL
· A reverse-proxy tool, specifically tailored to mitigate web application vulnerabilities.
· Provides extra security by shielding web applications to reduce surface attacks.
· Provides a black box approach for shielding and testing web applications against bypass attacks.
